note: Two separate sites about 550 m apart on Chestnut Ridge Road, 0.7 and 1.2 miles from its junction with Pipeline Road. CR 001 is an open grass clearing entered over a short grass driveway, which the agency calls well suited for equestrian use or group camping. CR 002 is a gravel site in woods beside a deer exclosure fence. Stone fire rings; no tables, toilets or drinking water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: CR 001 and CR 002 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, 'Trailer Site' category only, 45 and 40 ft, pull-in driveways (grass 20 ft; gravel 40 ft), all grades Slight; count 2 and 45 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; both sell in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery: CR 001 (Esri) is a grass clearing about 35 x 12 m just north of the pin, open sky; CR 002 is under closed canopy on Esri and in woods beside forest tracks on PASDA leaf-off, no pad made out. The sites are 555 m apart on the same road (not a split). NHD: nothing within 200 m of CR 001; an unnamed stream 188 m from CR 002; not waterfront.
flags: GRASS DRIVEWAY (ruling 11 applied, kept): CR 001's page gives 'Driveway Surface: Grass', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Length: 20', 'Site Grade: Slight'. The agency says nothing about steepness or wet conditions, so the site stays; nothing was measured.

Equestrian wording: CR 001 'Campsite is well suited for equestrian use or group camping' (GIS: 'Good for large group or equestrian use', HitchingPost No). It is not an equestrian-only site and lists the 'Trailer Site' category. Kept.
EQUIPMENT (rulings 4 and 8, reported not raised): the page lists 'Looking For Category: Trailer Site' on both sites with no 'RV Site' category; Max Vehicle Length 40, Site Access Drive-In. Kept.
No overhead clearance figure on CR 001's page; imagery shows an open clearing. CR 002 posts 30 ft.
Both pages print 'Hike In Distance to Site' (20 and 40) beside 'Site Access: Drive-In'; the figures equal the driveway lengths and the unit is not stated.
DCNR GIS lists 'Water: Non-Potable' for CR 001; the booking page lists no water. potable_water written false.
Pin: stored 41.53339,-77.56202 is CR 001's point, about 12 m south of the clearing's centre; left alone. CR 002 is at 41.53151,-77.55585, 555 m east-south-east; same road, not a split candidate.
Water: nothing within 200 m of CR 001; an unnamed NHD stream 188 m from CR 002, woods between. Not waterfront, no lead.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): all grades Slight on both pages; no caution line on either. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own number and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: CR 001 / CR 002, Chestnut Ridge Road'); nothing to change.

Equestrian/ATV check: the Tiadaghton horseback page names no horse camp; the ATV page names only the Haneyville ATV Trail (trailhead on SR 44 on its brochure map). The 2024 ATV Regional Trail Connector Pilot map linked from the advisories page answered 404 and is UNREAD.

Tiadaghton advisories page (read 2026-11-10): Brown's Run and Sinking Springs Roads closed to snowmobiles with a detour (2024-2025 season); 'Stay alert for ATVs' (ATV pilot uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory for the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail; Dividing Line Trail closed indefinitely; e-bike rules. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice on this entry's road. The Tiadaghton camping page publishes no seasonal closure, hunting-season rule or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.'
